title: Transitrix field artefact (ingest)
description: A field-zone artefact emitted by the ingest pipeline from one converted source document. Carries the admission record (CONTRACT.md §6) with a proposed source_quality (§11.2) and a type-specific body block the extraction step reads. The skill proposes; a human confirms source_quality at admission.

id.description: Canonical ID: <TYPE>-[<middle>-]<INTEGER>. For field artefacts the TYPE is the document type and the convention includes a date stamp, e.g. INTERVIEW-cfo-strategy-20260415-1.

admitted_by.description: Person handle or tool identifier that ran the field admission gate. Never a personal email.

gate_checks.description: The field zone's standard check is `provenance` (CONTRACT.md §6).

source_quality.description: PROPOSED trust in the source (CONTRACT.md §11.2). Closed ordinal set; weight is informational. A human confirms at admission. Absent ⇒ downstream confidence scoring treats the source as `unverified`. Field-zone only: codex sources are authoritative by construction and carry no source_quality (14-codex.md §3.6).

source_quality_proposed_by.description: Tool identifier that proposed source_quality, so the human confirmation is auditable. Optional.

provenance.description: Who / when / in what setting the material came from. The recorded source of the material is the field zone's contract.

captured_by.description: Who recorded the material (handle or tool id).

subject_role.description: Role of the source (e.g. "Chief Financial Officer") — a role, never a named person.

setting.description: Context in which the material was captured.

raw_source.description: Path, relative to the org root, to the retained raw file in _intake/processed/ — the byte-level source this artefact was derived from, kept for traceability. The field-zone analogue of a codex artefact's `snapshot_file` (14-codex.md §3.6): the same retained-source-copy concept, named per zone.

source_hash.description: Content fingerprint of the raw bytes the artefact was derived from. Provides tamper-evidence and source-replacement detection: a re-saved 'same' file is detected by hash mismatch, and adopters with audit needs (GDPR / SOX / ISO 27001) can prove a field record actually derives from this specific source. Format: '<algo>:<hex>', currently 'sha256:<64 lowercase hex>'.

notes.description: Body block for type INTERVIEW — free-text transcript or notes the extraction step reads.

responses.description: Body block for type SURVEY — structured or free-text answers.

observations.description: Body block for type OBSERVATION — what was directly observed.

content.description: Body block for type DRAFT — working draft awaiting admission.

allOf.description: Each field TYPE carries its own body block.
